overview: A young and ambitious prison officer finds herself in the middle of a battle for the criminal underworld as crime lords try to evade justice. But in order to do that, she will have to learn quickly to put her faith in one of the very men she wants to put behind bars.

name: Love Is Better the Second Time Around
originalName: 恋をするなら二度目が上等
overview: Journalist Akihiro reunites with Takashi, his high school love, now a professor. Old emotions resurface as they navigate between professionalism and the past.

name: 入り浸りギャルにま〇こ使わせて貰う話
originalName: 入り浸りギャルにま〇こ使わせて貰う話

name: The Four Seasons
overview: The decades-long friendship between three married couples is tested when one divorces, complicating their tradition of quarterly weekend getaways.

name: Mind the Noona Gap
overview: A provocative and honest love story about a man and woman with a younger partner who overcome the barrier of age difference and are bold and honest in their love.

name: Tamon's B-Side
overview: Utage Kinoshita is a high school girl who works part-time as a housekeeper. She has devoted her life to her favorite idol, Tamon Fukuhara, from the group F/ACE. Then one day, Utage ends up being assigned to Tamon’s house! There she discovers that off-stage, he is nothing like his wild idol persona. A gloomy, introverted boy with no self-confidence, Utage still finds herself falling for him anyway.

name: All the Queen's Men
overview: Marilyn "Madam" DeVille is at the top of her game in the Atlanta nightclub industry, and she won't let anyone or anything stand her in way as she rules a crew of male exotic dancers.

name: Fresh off the Sea
overview: A coastal journey exploring beach jobs and local seafood delights. Watch Yum Jung-ah, Ahn Eun-jin, Park Jun-myun, and DEX embark on a fun-filled seaside adventure across the country.

name: Remnants of Gold
overview: Three hundred thousand taels of gold suddenly surface in the vast desert, where rumor has it that all who seek the treasure are doomed to become vengeful spirits. An officer of the Imperial Guard sent to investigate descends into madness on his very first day. A loyal and courageous deputy envoy who has ventured too far to turn back finds himself torn between desire and honor. After her entire family is slaughtered, a woman immune to all poisons returns to the vast desert, deliberately making herself the prize every faction is determined to seize as she sets out for revenge. Beneath the vast desert's sweeping sands lie an insatiable greed for gold and a carefully laid trap designed to lure her into the deadly game. From a relay station and an armed escort agency to a general's residence, a band of martial heroes becomes entangled in a deadly struggle across the vast and desolate frontier, bringing the spirit and ideals of Eastern wuxia to life in a new light.

name: CHEF of CHINA
overview: CHEF of CHINA unleashes China's ultimate culinary showdown! 100 outstanding chefs, armed with blades and fiery woks, channel their reverence for 5,000 years of gastronomic legacy into explosive battles. Through knife-edge duels and creative gauntlets, they'll conquer flavor frontiers to claim the ultimate crown, "Chef of China"!

name: Double Helix
overview: Years after being torn apart by family and fate, two former lovers reunite as boss and employee, forced to confront a love they can't escape.

name: The Devil's Hour
overview: Lucy wakes every night at exactly 3:33am. Nothing in her life has made sense for a long time. But the answers are out there, somewhere, at the end of a trail of brutal murders.

name: Zhan Zhao Adventures
overview: Zhan Zhao, a fourth-ranked imperial guard, embarks on a solo investigation after receiving evidence of a cold case. Along the way, he encounters the strong-willed Miss Huo Linglong and the justice-driven Bai Yutang. The three like-minded companions join forces to uncover clues, uphold justice, and capture criminals. Together, they work to expose a dangerous web of power that has infiltrated both the court and the martial world, ultimately restoring peace to the people.

name: Cold
overview: Zhenya is being unfairly imprisoned for an accident on Kutuzovsky Prospekt that killed her husband and 6-year-old daughter. The real culprits of the accident are the majors, whose powerful parents "help" the court to make the "right" decision.

name: The Undeclared War
overview: In the post-pandemic world of 2024 during an upcoming British general election involving the UK’s first Black Conservative prime minister, a leading team of analysts at the heart of the UK’s NSA-style spy agency GCHQ attempt to ward off a cyber-attack on the country’s electoral system.

name: Fist of the North Star: HOKUTO NO KEN
originalName: 北斗の拳 -FIST OF THE NORTH STAR-
overview: In the year 199X, the world was engulfed in nuclear fire!! Yet...humanity somehow survived!! A lone man with seven scars on his chest emerges. His name is Kenshiro, heir to Hokuto Shinken. In a world where only the strong survive, Kenshiro forges a path with his iron fists!

name: Born with Luck
overview: Zhang Yi'ang, a veteran detective, is sent to Sanjiangkou to investigate a case but soon finds himself caught in a web of crime and corruption. While pursuing a powerful criminal network, he unexpectedly receives help from a group of bungling thieves, who inadvertently aid his mission to unravel the truth behind a murder.

name: The Edge of Horizon
overview: Years after being torn apart by rank and tradition, a prince and his first love reunite as buried feelings bloom once more.

name: The Hardacres
overview: The sweeping rags to riches story of the Hardacres, a working-class family in 1890s Yorkshire who strike it rich and move from a grimy fish dock to a vast estate.

name: The QUEEN of News
overview: The highly-watched 6:30 PM news report is the battleground for news anchors. In the news department, seasoned anchors Man Wai-sum and Leung Ging-yan split into two factions, each vying for the top spot. Wen causes quite a stir and eventually climbs the corporate ladder. The vacancy for the prime-time female anchor sparks a series of storms!

name: A Splendid Match
overview: After years away from her family, Gu Jinzhao returns home and begins a remarkable transformation, from a carefree young woman into a poised and influential noble lady. As questions of marriage arise, she refuses to follow tradition and holds firmly to her own beliefs about love. But when multiple men enter her life, each offering a different future, who will Gu Jinzhao choose?

name: Yowayowa Sensei
overview: Hiyori Hiwamura is known as the "Scary Teacher," and if you offend her, she'll put a curse on you! Or at least that's what everyone believes. She's secretly a total softy who's deeply misunderstood, and once you see her sweet side, she'll put a different kind of spell on you.

name: The Husband
overview: Taeju and Seyun are on the verge of divorce. But when a drunken comment from Taeju gets Seyun kidnapped, everything changes. Even worse, he's now the prime suspect. Forced to go on the run, Taeju must rescue his wife on his own. To save her, he pushes himself to the absolute limit.

name: Jet Lag: The Game
overview: Jet Lag: The Game is a travel competition show where instead of traveling to the competitions, travel is the competition. Each season brings a new game where the world is the board, with players competing against each other, sleep deprivation, flight delays, broken-down cars, and the bizarre challenges they quickly regret having created.

name: Erlong Lake: Blossoms of Hometown Dreams
overview: Zhang Hao, a city security guard, returns to his rural hometown, Erlong Lake Village, pretending to be a successful businessman after bragging to the locals about his achievements. He reconnects with Li Minghan, a recent graduate dedicated to revitalizing their village. Despite their different backgrounds and values, their interactions spark a series of comedic events. As Zhang Hao becomes the village's unlikely hope, he faces mounting pressure from the community, while his lack of business experience leaves him vulnerable to scammers.

name: Signal
overview: Detectives from the present and a detective from the past communicate via walkie-talkie to solve a long-time unsolved case.

name: Bobby's Triple Threat
overview: Features one competitor per episode who enters Bobby's secret kitchen to compete against professional chefs in three head-to-head rounds. If the competitor can out-cook the titans and earn more points, they take home the cash prize.

name: Scooped Up by an S-Rank Adventurer!
originalName: 勇者パーティーを追放された白魔導師、Sランク冒険者に拾われる ～この白魔導師が規格外すぎる～
overview: Lloyd is a white mage who was unexpectedly banished from the hero's party. As he was lost and uncertain, he happened to cross paths with an S-rank adventurer party in need of a white mage, so he joined them on their quest. Little did anyone know at the time that the hero's party would fall apart and Lloyd would rise to fame.

name: Against the Gods
overview: Hunted for possessing a heaven-defying object, Yun Che is a young man in both that life and the next. Throwing himself off a cliff to spite his pursuers, Yun Che is reincarnated as Xiao Che, a recently poisoned teen in another realm. Just as hated in this life as the previous one, Che must overcome his own hostile clan, his own inability to cultivate, and his own frosty fiancée.

name: SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table
overview: Yuki plays death games for a living, but when she wakes in a mansion with five other women, can she survive a new lethal maze of locked rooms and traps?

name: Moonshadow
originalName: เงาใต้พระจันทร์
overview: An unconventional arrangement following a one-night stand develops into genuine love between two women, but their relationship is tested when one woman's first love unexpectedly returns.

name: The Other Bennet Sister
overview: Mary isn't your typical period drama heroine. She is awkward, anxious, preachy, full of facts, a terrible singer, overlooked by her mother and seemingly destined to an empty dance card for the rest of her life… until Mary takes matters into her own hands.

name: Ren Yu
overview: A missing person case forces three girls from different walks of life to face life-altering choices, exposing the ups and downs of an ordinary family. The story intertwines the light and dark sides of the city—above ground and in the underground tunnels. As one girl navigates these challenges alone, she uncovers the truth, finds redemption, and moves toward a hopeful future.

name: Song of the Samurai - Chapter: Youthful Days in Edo
originalName: ちるらん 新撰組鎮魂歌 江戸青春篇
overview: A live-action adaptation that translates this deep legacy to the screen. Set in Kyoto at the end of the Edo period, the story depicts the intense and passionate lives of the Shinsengumi - the iconic samurai force that defended Kyoto in the final years of Japan's shogunate - through spectacular action and a bold interpretation based on historical facts. The story follows street brawler Toshizo Hijikata (Yuki Yamada), who finds a new kind of family in Isami Kondo and Soji Okita. Hijikata and his comrades in the Shinsengumi forge a bond of loyalty - tested by betrayal, illness, and war - as they fight not only their enemies but their own ideals.

name: Death Inc.
overview: When the founder of Torregrosa Funeral Home dies, his scheming right-hand man is poised to take over the business. But the owner's widow has other plans.

name: Girl from Nowhere: The Reset
originalName: เด็กใหม่ The Reset
overview: In a new universe, the mysterious Nanno poses as a transfer student, exposing cruelty by turning power, guilt and desire against those who abuse them.

name: The Shadow Sovereign
overview: A low-born scholar rises to power to avenge his father, only to find an unexpected alliance and deep love with the defiant princess he once vowed to destroy.

name: Under Salt Marsh
overview:
Morfa Halen is a tight-knit Welsh town precariously nestled between towering mountains and a fast-encroaching sea that threatens its very existence. As a once-in-a-generation storm begins to gather far out at sea, former detective turned teacher Jackie Ellis discovers the body of her 8-year-old pupil, Cefin, seemingly drowned.

The discovery sends shockwaves through the community, reviving the ghost of an unsolved cold case that rocked the town three years prior - the disappearance of Jackie’s niece, Nessa, which cost her career.

name: GATE24: The Border
overview: A newly formed airport task force overcomes institutional barriers and uses an eccentric officer's extraordinary observational skills to protect Japan's borders from international crimes.

name: Game of Flame
overview: A culinary competition celebrating Chinese ingredients gathers top star chefs and unique folk cooks to face intense survival challenges, with celebrity judges and industry experts watching as one is crowned “Chef King of the Year.”

name: My Dearest Nemesis
overview: Baek Su-jeong leads a planning team at a renowned department store. She meets her new boss, Ban Ju-yeon, her first love from an online game 16 years ago, stirring up memories of when he confessed his feelings but she rejected him.

name: New Recruit
overview: A hyper-realistic comedy depicting the story of a 'military' recruit enlisting in a place where all kinds of people, from the good to the bad to the weird, gather.

name: Please Excuse My Younger Brothers
originalName: うちの弟どもがすみません
overview: High school sophomore Ito was excited for a new dad when her mom remarried, but she may have gained more than she bargained for when she found four younger stepbrothers waiting at home. There’s blunt but secretly caring Gen, calm Raku, reclusive Syu, and cheerful little Rui. Now, Ito must go from the quiet of being an only child to learning how to be the eldest sister of a lively household.

name: The Klutzy Class Monitor and the Girl with the Short Skirt
originalName: ポンコツ風紀委員とスカート丈が不適切なJKの話
overview: Every morning, Sakuradaimon-kun enforces the rules at the school gate, stopping Poem-chan for her too-short skirt. But when they’re thrown together in remedial class, she discovers his secret—the serious, uptight Sakuradaimon-kun is hopeless at studying! As they clash, bicker, and stumble through school life together, the two opposites slowly draw closer and form an unexpected friendship.

name: Young Ladies Don't Play Fighting Games
originalName: 対ありでした。～お嬢さまは格闘ゲームなんてしない～
overview: Mitsuki Aya has one goal at the elite Kuromi Girls’ Academy: to become a refined young lady like the school’s flawless “White Lily,” Yorue Mio. But her image of Mio shatters when Aya accidentally catches her...playing fighting games?! Turns out, the elegant Mio is actually a hardcore gamer—and she wants to duel Aya! The battle (and their friendship) begins.

name: Love Island
overview: A stunning cast engages in the ultimate game of love, as they land in a sunshine paradise in search of passion and romance. Each of the glamorous members of the public will live like celebrities in a luxury villa, but in order to stay there, they will not only have to win over the hearts of each other, but also the hearts of the public.

name: This Is My Adventure
overview: In order to embrace the pioneering spirit of the new era and to seek the true essence of a fulfilling life, twelve sea-loving youngsters venture to a mysterious island. Through a series of survival tests and challenges, they find a way to coexist with nature and achieve self-growth and breakthroughs, embodying the younger generation's adventurous ethos of the modern age.

name: Crowned in a Hundred Days
overview:
Driven to the brink of despair, restaurant owner Ming forms an unlikely bond with the soul of the true King Lie after swallowing it to save his loved one. Bound together by fate, the two embark on a perilous journey to challenge the tyrant who has usurped the throne.

With only one hundred days to change their destiny, Ming uses his extraordinary memory to master long-lost magic, gathering allies and winning the support of the people along the way. As their strength grows, so does their resolve to overthrow a corrupt regime, reclaim the rightful king's throne, and restore peace to the realm.

name: Family Register
overview: Judged as a mistress’s daughter, a young woman fights a stigma she never chose. Meanwhile, another woman’s life stands still after her husband's betrayal. Bound together by the death of the man who tore their lives apart, these two apparent enemies are forced to confront one another under one roof. As families scarred by hatred and heartbreak collide, old wounds resurface. Facing years of prejudice, they set out to reclaim their lives and transform their bitter fate into an unexpected family bond.

name: That Night
overview: When a young, naïve single mother gets embroiled in a murder during an island getaway, her sisters rush to help. But they only make things worse.

name: Deadloch
overview: Two vastly different female detectives are thrown together to solve the murder of a local man in the sleepy seaside hamlet of Deadloch.

name: Love Upon a Time
overview: A modern man is transported 400 years into the past, where he must pose as a missing criminal's son while falling for a suspicious noble.

name: Caught in the Act: Unfaithful
overview: Host Tami Roman sets out on a mission geared at empowering suspicious lovers in catching their cheating partners whle in the middle of the act. With a little help from relationship expert Kevin Carr and private investigator Brianne Joseph, she manages to uncover both the truth and the receipts required to expose the cheats. If caught cheating, the show gives the victims of infidelity a choice when it comes to bringing justice: they can team up with the other lover, or ambush both the partner and their lover together.

name: Proud
overview: When his carefree life is upended by an unexpected family tragedy, Filip is forced to grow up or risk losing all that he has left.

name: Possession
overview: Claudia, a bi-racial lawyer, journeys to Jamaica's haunted Connaught plantation to fight an inheritance claim. Uncovering dark historical secrets intertwined with modern injustices intensifies her nightmare.

name: The Miniature Wife
overview: Lindy and Les, a married writer and scientist, are forced to re-evaluate the power balances in their relationship after a freak accident shrinks Lindy down to 6 inches tall.

name: Fallen
overview: A young woman is sent to a cult-like rehab facility called Sword & Cross to serve time for a crime she can't remember committing. Among the other residents, she encounters the enigmatic Daniel and exasperating but irresistible Cam, all of whom are under the watchful eye of the sinister chief doctor Howson, and devout twin sisters Miriam and Sophia. Luce must untangle the mystery of who she is and why she has a connection to Daniel that goes far back beyond their time in the institution

name: GBRB: Farm Operation - Go Go Farm
originalName: 콩 심은 데 콩 나는 가고팜 하고팜 동물농장
overview: The GBRB crew returns for a new challenge as Lee Kwang Soo, Kim Woo Bin, and Doh Kyung Soo swap city life for the ranch. Spending several days alongside experienced ranchers, the trio learns the essentials of raising dairy cows and horses while experiencing the hard work and philosophy behind livestock farming. From feeding animals to tackling demanding daily tasks, the three celebrities approach every mission with determination, humor, and plenty of mishaps. Their playful chemistry and growing bond with the animals create both hilarious and heartwarming moments. Blending comedy, friendship, and the charm of rural life, the show offers a refreshing look at ranch life and the unexpected rewards of working together in nature.

name: Deli Boys
overview: When their convenience store-magnate father suddenly dies, a pair of pampered Pakistani American brothers lose everything and are forced to reckon with their Baba's secret life of crime as they attempt to take up his mantle in the underworld.

name: Blades of the Guardians
overview: A extraordinary guard walks in the desert of the Western regions. On the way escaping the killing by the government, he took a guarding task with destination to the capital Chang 'an. The task was thought as just a simple one, but actually it is a road full of crisis and danger. A journey affecting the fate of the world begins......

name: Fifties Professionals
overview: Three seemingly ordinary but deadly uncles, whose fate sets them in motion again. It depicts the everyday lives of three middle-aged men, who have lived 50% of their lives, and the realistic comedy of these uncles who are even sadder because they were successful in their past.

name: De Férias com o Ex Diretoria
originalName: De Férias com o Ex Diretoria

name: Love on Paper
overview: When a tycoon prunes her academic dreams, a driven florist signs a temporary pact with her nemesis. As corporate logic wilts under raw chemistry, an unexcavated past threatens to shred their paper-thin “romance”.

name: The American Revolution
overview: The American Revolution was at once a war for independence, a war of conquest, a civil war, and a world war, fought by neighbors on American farms and between global powers an ocean or more away. It impacted millions from Vermont’s Green Mountains to the swamps of South Carolina, from Indian Country to the Iberian Peninsula. In defeating the British Empire and giving birth to a new nation, the American Revolution turned the world upside-down. Thirteen colonies on the Atlantic Coast united in rebellion, won their independence, and established a republic that still endures. The American Revolution will present the story of the men and women of the Revolutionary generation, their humanity in victory and defeat, and the crisis that they lived through.

name: In Search of Gods
overview: The story takes place in the untamed era of Yandi and Huangdi. As various powers vie for control of the Central Plains, the universally recognized leader of the world, Shennong the Great, passes away. The chieftains of the five tribes—Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth—begin to stir with ambition. In these turbulent times, a young man named Tuoba Ye emerges like a comet. By a stroke of chance, he inherits Shennong’s dying legacy and embarks on a thrilling, legendary journey.

name: Oriental Martial Academy
overview:
Orphan Qin Yu was specially admitted to the top cultivation academy, Dongda Martial Academy. Behind the city's calm, a demonic threat quietly approached. Qin Yu vowed to lead his fellow disciples to resist the invading demons.

Recommendations

name: In Love Forever
originalName: วาดฝันวันวิวาห์
overview:
After a bitter divorce caused by family pressure and emotional manipulation, successful lawyer Runchlaphat and outspoken Gen-Z heiress Peeracha want nothing to do with each other. But when a high-stakes business opportunity requires them to appear as a happily married couple, the former lovers are forced back under the same roof.

As they struggle to maintain the illusion, unresolved feelings and painful memories begin to resurface. Meanwhile, Runchlaphat’s controlling mother, Gingkamol, remains determined to keep Peeracha out of the family at all costs. Surrounded by deception, pride, and lingering desire, the ex-wives find themselves trapped between the love they once shared and the wounds they never healed.

name: Chasing Love
originalName: พี่เองก็ลำบาก
overview:
Song, a hot nerd and food researcher, arranged a one-night stand with a mysterious woman under a strict condition: no strings attached. However, the other party broke the terms, asking for an emotional connection. Song ended the steamy encounter and walked away.

But the world really is round. That woman turned out to be Piangrawin—the daughter of the president of the company where Song worked. And Piangrawin wasn’t letting go easily. She pursued her with puppy-like devotion, entangling Song's heart and routine with reckless charm. She even claimed she’d already named their future child.

name: Straight to Hell
overview: As Japan's most famous fortune teller, Kazuko Hosoki ruled TV and bestseller lists, but who was she behind rumors of spiritual scams and underworld ties?

name: Booked: First Day In
overview: Follows arrested individuals through America’s booking process, offering an extraordinary look at the most unusual, bizarre and often tense bookings. Each episode follows the story of an arrestee, with their permission, as they move through the system and recount what ultimately led them to their time in jail. From petty offenses to serious crimes, viewers will be taken on a harrowing adventure while they watch the arrestees throughout the booking process.

name: Deep Revenge
originalName: ディープリベンジ-顔を捨てた家政婦-
overview:
The protagonist, Nozomi, was on the peak of happiness after conceiving a child with her husband, Ryoichi, but she was involved in an accident whilst on holiday.

When she next awoke, she was told that the baby she was carrying had been stillborn, and that four years had passed.

name: The Five Star Weekend
overview: After her husband's unexpected death and a very public breakdown, famed cook Hollis hosts her best friends for an elaborate weekend on Nantucket.

name: Agents of the Four Seasons Dance of Spring
originalName: 春夏秋冬代行者 春の舞
overview: When the Agent of Spring, Hinagiku Kayo, is abducted, spring itself vanishes—plunging the world into unending winter. Refusing to give up, her devoted guard, Sakura Himedaka, searches for her for years. When Hinagiku suddenly returns, the two set out to restore the lost season, face the past that tore them apart, and reclaim the warmth they refuse to lose again.

name: Star Blazers: Space Battleship Yamato 3199
overview: In 2207, two years after Gamilas and Iscandar vanished, a colossal object, the “Grand Reverse” appears, effortlessly breaching Earth’s defenses. Swarms of troops and multi-legged tanks swiftly conquer Earth’s capital city. Amidst the chaos, the old Yamato crew receives a secret order and now begins a voyage for unseen dimensions while humanity’s fate hangs in the balance.

name: Emergency 53
overview: Doctors, nurses and drivers of a special mobile service unit navigate personal and professional dramas while burdened by the responsibility to prevent others from dying.

name: Canada's Drag Race: All Stars
overview: Nine queens are back with unfinished business, competing for the chance to be crowned “Canada’s Ultimate All-Star” and win a cash prize of $100,000.

name: The Great Queen
overview: Modern girl Xi Yuan travels to the realm of Xuanji, where she faces numerous dangers, and her true identity and hidden powers gradually emerge. With the realm's safety at stake, Xi Yuan bravely confronts significant challenges, demonstrating her courage and resilience while striving to protect those around her.

name: Forræder
overview: An entertaining crime mystery with 18 players. Who can see through lies? Who is the best tactician in the game? And who will end up with the entire prize pool? Only one thing is certain: Trust no one.

name: Whenever Possible
overview: We're looking for someone who has free time to hang out with us. Whenever Possible.

name: Wind-Born Warriors
overview: Brigade Commander Xu Lingjun is assigned to lead a military transformation pilot program. Despite challenges, he trusts Battalion Commander Guo Zijian, who proves himself after a past training accident. In a crucial exercise against an undefeated opponent, they use their innovative tactics to turn the tide.

name: The Tribute
overview: The story follows Adolfo Novak, a powerful family patriarch, whose 80th birthday celebration uncovers decades of secrets, betrayals, loyalties, and a thirst for revenge.

name: Drag Race Philippines
overview: The hit global drag phenomenon is now in the Philippines! Watch as 12 iconic queens slay and race to the finish line and compete to be the first ever Drag Race Superstar from the Philippines. It’s the Filipinos’ time to shine, henny... and you ain’t seen nothing yet!

name: Raised by Demons: Panda Li
overview: Li Xiongmao, a human boy raised by demons, who leaves the Black and White Mountain on his master's orders to kill three enemies who destroyed the demon race. Amid investigation, he uncovers the conflict between humans and demons, the secrets of the dynasty, and the mystery of his own destiny.

name: Sweetpea
overview: Rhiannon Lewis doesn't make much of an impression - people walk past her in the street without a second glance. That is until she is pushed over the edge and loses control. Rhiannon's life transforms, but can she keep her killer secret?

name: Ash
overview: An undercover cop and a secretive CEO spark a dangerous romance amid a brutal crime war, realizing the only person they can trust is each other.

name: The Legend of Rosy Clouds
overview: In the legendary Nine Cities, noblewoman Fan Yun and cunning lord Qi Zheng join forces to overcome a looming crisis. As they fight for the people's welfare, their bond deepens into friendship and love to bring peace and prosperity to the realm.

name: The Scarecrow
overview: A fiercely competitive police officer and an idealistic prosecutor, former high school classmates, reunite while investigating a nationwide serial murder case, pulling them into both a dangerous pursuit and an unresolved personal past.

name: Conversations with a Killer: The Charles Manson Tapes
originalName: Conversations with a Killer: The Charles Manson Tapes
overview: Tracing Charles Manson's rise as a cult leader, the 1969 murders, and his trial, using unreleased prison recordings, interviews, and archival footage.

name: The Trembling of Cicada
overview: Three legal professionals with troubled pasts become entangled in complex criminal cases, where psychological warfare, hidden agendas, and long-buried secrets blur the line between hunter and prey.

name: Secret Service
overview: A British intelligence officer Kate Henderson races against time to uncover a UK politician's potential ties with the Kremlin, risking her reputation and family, as a murder and election loom.

name: Ann Droid
overview: It’s Sue’s worst nightmare - an overly attentive, socially inept, second-hand robot carer. But maybe this droid has its uses...

name: Dragon Striker
overview: In a world where sports and magic combine, farm boy Key discovers his ultrapowerful natural talent and learns he could be the legendary Dragon Striker.

name: Botan Kamiina Fully Blossoms When Drunk
originalName: 上伊那ぼたん、酔へる姿は百合の花
overview: New university life, new dormmates…and a whole new world of drinks! Botan Kamiina takes her first sip of alcohol after spotting the quiet dorm leader, Ibuki Tonami, enjoying a highball alone. From shochu to whisky, Botan shares the joy of drinking with friends, while Ibuki slowly learns that some pleasures are better when shared.

name: Ms. X
overview: A suburban mom and her high school friend plot to frighten her unfaithful husband straight, but their scheme spirals into murder, trapping her between law enforcement, drug lords, and ruthless PTA moms.

name: Belflower
overview: An invested father-in-law, Nicolas is devastated when his girlfriend leaves him and cuts him off. So he takes refuge in his childhood hometown to find his friends and navigate with them through their lives as modern men.

name: The Traitors Ireland
overview: 22 strangers are pitted against each other in a remote castle, where they must play a game an imaginative game of strategy. The twist? Some players, known as the Traitors, are secretly tasked with eliminating their competitors each night without being detected.

name: Elegy for the Henchmen: Fist of the North Star
originalName: 北斗の拳 拳王軍ザコたちの挽歌
overview: A young man named Nobu, who is looking for a job in the post-apocalyptic world, ends up tricked into joining Raoh's Army.

name: Sin And Love
overview: Police officers, drug dealers, and spies: a mysterious kidnapping uncovers a criminal network, while love and sex become tools of exchange.

name: Spring Over Phoenix Pond
overview: Qi Yuan, a butcher’s daughter who is secretly the true heiress of a noble family, suffers betrayal and persecution at the hands of a false heiress. After becoming a guard for Prince Jing, Xiao Yunting, she develops feelings for him. However, tragedy strikes on their wedding night, leading to her death. Reborn, Qi Yuan sets out to change her fate, seeking revenge and a second chance at love.

name: The Lead
overview: Yi Qin'e is taken to the cultural troupe by her uncle Hu Sanyuan to learn to sing Qinqiang Opera. From then on, her life unfolds with ups and downs. She achieves glorious artistic accomplishments, yet also experiences a profound sense of loneliness beyond ordinary people's comprehension.

name: Tune In to the Midnight Heart
originalName: 真夜中ハートチューン
overview: Arisu Yamabuki is heir to a powerful conglomerate, and seeks perfection. After Apollo, the host of Midnight Heart Tune, vanishes, Arisu joins the Fuurin High broadcasting club. There, he meets four girls and promises to make their vocal dreams come true!

name: Let’s Marry Harry
overview: To marry Jowsey, he’s not the only one you’ll need to hit it off with. The prospective brides will also need to make a good impression on his friends, so Jowsey is handing the reins of his love life to his three closest confidants, Amanda Kloots, Georgia Hassarati, and Sonny Henty. The trio will step in to make tough calls and guide him on his journey from player to life partner.

name: Play Me
overview: The top star Jung Yihyun, who started as a child actor, decides to quit the entertainment industry due to his mother's sudden death. Kang Jaewon, a part-time worker who lives from hand to mouth, has to temporarily give up his actor dream due to real-life pressures. The two, who had a falling-out in high school due to a misunderstanding, reunite years later because of a musical. Through portraying the characters, they rediscover love.

name: Gold Land
overview: A young woman working as an airport security agent accidentally comes into possession of a smuggling ring’s gold bars. Caught in a chaotic whirlwind of greed and betrayal among various parties vying for the gold, she becomes consumed by the desire to claim it all for herself.

name: Our Universe
overview: Two in-laws forced to raise their orphaned nephew together slowly overcome their misunderstandings, finding personal growth and an unexpected romance through co-parenting under one roof.

name: Lock Upp
overview: Lockupp is a 24*7 captive reality show which has 16 celebrities locked inside the queen’s jail for 72 days. Who will survive the badass jail and play atyachaari khel?

name: Ticket to Heaven
originalName: เด็กชายไม่ไปสวรรค์
overview: A grieving student pursuing priesthood faces a crisis of faith when he falls for a troubled new classmate in a world ruled by strict dogma.

name: A Beautiful Obsession
overview: An intimate, raw portrait of Manchester City FC across two era-defining seasons. With unprecedented access, the film follows their worst run in decades and fightback to glory.

name: Drag Race Mexico: Latina Royale
overview: A cast of all Latin Queens from different shows across the Drag Race global franchise in a battle for the crown.

name: Agent from Above
overview: Bound by a deity's pact, Han Chieh fights demons on Earth. When he uncovers an old enemy's plan for a second invasion, he must fight to save humanity.

name: Lion
overview: The extraordinary true story of lion cub Kio, on his journey to become a king.

name: Boy Hood 2
overview: A struggling school basketball team is saved when a group of students come together to keep it alive. As they face challenges on and off the court, their growing friendship helps them discover teamwork and navigate the challenges of youth.

name: Surviving Earth
overview: Meet the bizarre, amazing and breathtaking creatures and landscapes of a vibrant lost world; and discover how life not only survived during the cataclysmic events of this prehistoric era, but thrived.

name: Light to the Night
overview: In 1997, a disappearance inside an elevator pulls detectives He Yuanhang and Ran Fangxu into a twisted mystery. Facing doubt and confusion along the way, they press on to uncover the truth. As time moves on, they heal from life's uncertainties, hold fast to justice, and rise above hardship with resilience and hope.

name: A Father's Debt
overview: A retired chef's plans for a peaceful life are disrupted when his youngest son is defrauded of a large sum of money. Though not legally responsible for the debt, he sells his home and returns to work to help his son repay it.

name: My Status as an Assassin Obviously Exceeds the Hero's
originalName: 暗殺者である俺のステータスが勇者よりも明らかに強いのだが
overview: Akira Oda and his high school classmates are summoned to another world! While the other students are granted cheat abilities through the summoning, Akira merely gains the abilities of a mediocre "assassin." However, his status soon surpasses "hero," the strongest profession. After Akira becomes suspicious of the King behind the summoning, he is falsely framed for a crime and forced to flee.

name: The Rapture
overview: As temperatures rise, a convicted murderer foretells apocalyptic disaster - is she a manipulative psychopath or does she know the truth? High-stakes thriller crackling with danger.

name: The Vacation Principle
overview: After losing her job, a woman retreats to her late grandmother's seaside villa, where an unexpected friendship with its mysterious caretaker helps her heal and embrace a new beginning.

name: The Strongest Job Is Apparently Not a Hero or a Sage, But an Appraiser (Provisional)!
originalName: 最強の職業は勇者でも賢者でもなく鑑定士（仮）らしいですよ？
overview: High schooler Hibiki is transported to a monster-filled fantasy world, where he possesses only non-combat skills. However, through key encounters, he discovers hidden powers and embarks on an epic adventure.

name: NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE
overview: In a world where likes are currency and every viewer is a judge, OMGkawaiiAngel—also known as KAngel—is determined to become the ultimate "Internet Angel." Yet beneath her pastel smile and lively streams, there's more than meets the eye.

name: Bloody Smart
overview: In a town where strict rules shape students into their “best selves,” a hidden Bloodfruit Tree bears crimson fruit. A mysterious boy in black delivers these fruits only to those who truly “need” them. Once received, they awaken long-suppressed desires—gently unraveling the heart, and quietly leading the town toward irreversible collapse.

name: Karma
overview: A fateful accident intertwines six lives in a thrilling tale of karma and crime, where each must face their own dark truths and connections.

name: You and Everything Else
overview: From teen years to adulthood, two friends linked by warmth and tension grow apart — until one is asked to accompany the other through her final days.

name: The Girls: A Khloé Kardashian Project
originalName: The Girls: A Khloé Kardashian Project
overview: They're building empires. They're building families. They're always unfiltered. Welcome to The Girls, where Khloé Kardashian's inner circle of real-life besties are raising babies, running businesses, and surviving brutally honest group chats. From surprise proposals to solo parenting, glam getaways to growing pains, this is the new era of reality TV where the chaos is couture — and the bonds are unbreakable.

name: Deadly Sins
overview: Six intertwined cases reveal how unchecked desires corrupt morality and expose the darkest corners of human nature.

name: 90 Day: The Last Resort Between the Sheets
originalName: 90 Day: The Last Resort Between the Sheets
overview: An unfiltered after-show that dives deeper into each episode of 90 Day: The Last Resort (2023). Cast members provide behind-the-scenes commentary and personal reflections on their experiences at the resort. Through never-before-seen footage, and unique therapist interviews, viewers will get an exclusive insider look at what really went down when the cameras were and weren't rolling. This has all the juicy secrets, hilarious anecdotes and emotional moments as your favorite couples dissect jaw dropping scenes.

name: Fire Force
overview: Year 198 of the Solar Era in Tokyo, special fire brigades are fighting against a phenomenon called spontaneous human combustion where humans beings are turned into living infernos called "Infernals". While the Infernals are first generation cases of spontaneous human combustion, later generations possess the ability to manipulate flames while retaining human form. Shinra Kusakabe, a youth who gained the nickname Devil's Footprints for his ability to ignite his feet at will, joins the Special Fire Force Company 8 which composes of other flames users as they work to extinguish any Infernals they encounter. As a faction that is creating Infernals appears, Shira begins to uncover the truth behind a mysterious fire that caused the death of his family twelve years ago.

name: Your Sky: Hare Nochi Koi
overview: To dodge an aggressive upperclassman, Hinata enters a fake relationship with Sora, a cold senior. Can this chaotic lie blossom into something real?

name: Dark Side of the Cage
overview: Cutting through the glamour and glory of the MMA spectacle to reveal never-before-told stories behind its fighters.

name: Small Prophets
overview: The magical and mundane unfold in a suburban shed as a lonely man stumbles on the supernatural.

name: Cases Between Us
overview: Zhao Shaoshang and Yuan Hong, two young men from vastly different backgrounds, join forces to solve one case after another. Through their shared experiences, they learn from each other, grow together, and become an unstoppable crime-fighting duo in a tumultuous era.

name: Fired Up!
overview: Chou Lu-yung sets out to uncover the truth behind his father's death while managing the family restaurant, "Chin Lai Hao." He faces life’s challenges with his close friends and vows to seek justice for his father.

name: The Floor (PL)
overview: A dynamic quiz show in which one hundred contestants face off in a series of duels in the world's most spectacular quiz arena!

name: Law and the City
overview: Story of a lawyer who is known for his good appearance and straightforward personality and is working with Gyeongmin Law Firm for 9 years.

name: Morpheus
overview: The story of Piotr Leyer, a lawyer who, through a tragic twist of fate, becomes the head of a criminal gang.

name: Titanic Sinks Tonight
overview: Minute by minute - the night the unsinkable ship sank. Vivid first-hand accounts from passengers and crew tell the story of the most infamous disaster in maritime history.

name: Thunder 3
overview: Unremarkably ordinary middle schoolers, Pyontaro, Hiroshi and Tsubame, wander into an extraordinary adventure when Pyontaro's little sister goes missing.

name: See You Later... Maybe
overview: After being pushed to fake his death by a manipulative manager, fallen writer Fang Haowen teams up with obsessive fan Bie Fan as the "Jiongtu Duo", embarking on a chaotic redemption journey through fame, betrayal, and surreal reality.

name: Umthetho
overview: To keep their youngest brother alive, a state prosecutor becomes a double agent in her imprisoned older brother's gang.

name: The Iris Affair
overview: A rootless genius, Iris Nixon, steals an enigmatic code from a charming philanthropist and disappears. A tense countdown ensues as she races to unravel the code's mystery.

name: WEIRDO-101
originalName: แรงโน้มถ่วงระหว่างเรา
overview: A lazy judo athlete's life is turned upside down when a socially awkward astronomy genius saves him from trouble and openly pursues him.

name: Monkey Wrench
overview: A ragtag crew of mercenaries for hire chases down criminals across the galaxy. They're not the heroes we deserve, but they're the only ones we got.

name: Kabul
overview: Kabul, August 14, 2021. The Taliban are at the gates of the city, and France prepares to evacuate its embassy. But the sudden fall of Kabul the next day rushes all the plans. French, Italian, German, American diplomats and the police must improvise the evacuation of hundreds of Afghans and refugees to the airport. While chaos reaches the city, the Afghans will soon have only two choices: to kneel or to run away.

name: As Scheduled
overview: After a failed acting career, singer Jin Xi turns to musical theatre in hopes of rebuilding his reputation. Under the demanding guidance of renowned director Ning Jin, he struggles to earn the respect of the troupe while discovering his true passion for the stage.

name: 9/11: Reunited
overview: The story of September 11 through the eyes of survivors who experienced life-or-death moments with strangers that day and now want to meet again.

name: Until Death Do Us Part
overview: When family lawyer Malin and her husband Tobias have the neighbours over for a drink, the police come knocking. The babysitter supposed to be looking after Malin and Tobias's children has been murdered, and Tobias is the primary suspect.

name: Declassified: Operation Sindoor
overview: Following the Pahalgam terror attack in April, India's military leadership deliberates and plans Operation Sindoor, an 88-hour military operation launched on May 7, featuring accounts from operatives and experts.

name: My 2 Cents
overview: When his friend Wild Boar lands himself in hot water with organized crime, Zero and the gang unite to save him while barely coping with their own lives.

name: 1000-lb Roomies
overview: Self-proclaimed 'extra' in every way, Jaz and Nesha are each other's ride-or-die and co-conspirators in laughter, snacks and survival. But when Jaz' doctor gives her the shocking news that her life is at risk if she doesn't lose weight soon, the duo realizes that it's time to turn over a new leaf and kickstart their wellness journey. Jaz doesn't want to leave her daughter without a mother, so she commits to losing almost 200 lbs. Nesha, still not sold on surgery, isn't quite ready to jump on board. As roles shift and tensions rise, the pair must navigate new boundaries, old habits and the weight of what's at stake. The decision to change their lives and embark on this endeavor will test their commitment, willpower and unbreakable bond in unimaginable ways, but through it all, they will always have each other's backs.

name: The Fame
overview: Once inseparable, three friends were shattered by a tragedy they couldn’t escape. Years later, a kidnapping forces them back into each other’s lives—one in uniform, one in danger, and one under suspicion. Five years later, a brutal family massacre pulls them back into the storm. Guan-hao, long in hiding, comes face to face with death; Xin-yu is trapped in a violent marriage; Zhi-wei’s dreams of promotion collapse. A new trial begins—one of friendship, power, and desire.

name: Climax
overview: An ambitious prosecutor rises through Korea’s elite by marrying a famous actress, only to be pulled into a ruthless power cartel where hidden informants, corporate heirs, and political players collide in a brutal struggle for survival and control.

name: Jack & Joker: U Steal My Heart!
originalName: ทำไมต้องเป็นเธอทุกที
overview: To pay off his family's debt, a gifted taekwondo prodigy becomes the unwitting accomplice of a charismatic, legendary thief.

name: Drag Race Down Under vs The World
originalName: Drag Race Down Under vs The World
overview: Fan-favourites from Drag Race Down Under go head-to-head with sickening queens from around the world — all vying for the ultimate crown. Get ready for new looks, louder drama, and legendary lip-syncs as the battle for global drag dominance begins.

name: Xiao Fang
overview: It tells the story of Yang Xiaofang and Qi Xiaowei from the same village, who become pregnant before marriage. Yang's family rushes back to the village to strategize for Xiaofang. The Qi and Yang families have completely different attitudes, unexpectedly sparking a "marital storm." After negotiations between the two families fail, Xiaofang starts "blind dates while pregnant" — and surprisingly finds herself courted by the whole village, setting off a series of hilarious and laugh-out-loud events.

name: Monsters of God
overview: Filmmaker Eric Goode follows his first love — reptiles — into the dark underworld of exotic animal smuggling. In this billion-dollar global network, everyone is chasing the ultimate prize, whether it be owning the rarest of species, claiming the biggest fortunes, or taking down the most elusive criminals. As he digs deeper, Goode uncovers a labyrinth of outlaw traffickers, bombastic collectors, and the dogged law enforcement agents on their tails.

name: Summertime
overview: Yeo Eun Ho and Cha Do Hyeon have been friends all their lives. After 19 years, Eun Ho seems to have a good grasp on Do Hyeon, even knowing that his “perfect” image at school is a facade. But what Eun Ho is absolutely oblivious to is the fact that Do Hyeon has had an obsessive crush on him for years. Though Do Hyeon has been able to keep it a secret in order to slowly ease his way into Eun Ho’s heart, the sudden arrival of a new student named Kwon Yi Hyeon throws a wrench into his plans. What will Do Hyeon do to keep Eun Ho by his side? And will Eun Ho ever realize his best friend’s feelings for him?

name: Worst Neighbor Ever
overview: This intense documentary series details true stories of neighbors gone bad, from heinous fraud schemes to senseless acts of violent retribution.

name: Agents of Mystery
overview: Six "agents of mystery" with excellent chemistry probe into bizarre incidents that cannot be explained by science in creative and unique ways.

name: Disney Legends Award Ceremony
overview: Disney Legends Awards has honored gifted animators, Imagineers, songwriters, actors, business leaders, and more for the significant impact they’ve had on the Disney legacy. This bi-aunnal event celebrates a new class and look back at their many contributions to Disney magic.

name: A Good Day to Ascend
overview: In the chaotic times, demons and monsters roam freely, and treacherous officials are in power. With the invasion of the Netherworld, both humans and Netherworld beings wreak havoc on the mortal world, and the wild gods who work for the Netherworld bully the common people. Enraged, Xu Ying, a snake-catcher, rebels and commits the sin of killing a god, and also takes out an incompetent court official. Hunted down by the two realms, his fleeing begins...

name: Eclipse in the Lost City
overview: After his father is killed by the police chief, a gang heir secretly seeks revenge against the man responsible. But when he discovers that his supposed enemy is actually an undercover agent, the two join forces to expose a deadly conspiracy threatening the people of Ningcheng.

name: WWE: Unreal
overview: From Monday Night RAW to WrestleMania, this series goes backstage with WWE Superstars and staff as they bring the company's biggest spectacles to life.

name: Saved by the Ice Cold Prince's Embrace
originalName: 身代わり令嬢を救ったのは冷酷無慈悲な氷の王子の愛でした
overview: As the illegitimate daughter of a count and his maid, Katrina was born into miserable circumstances.  And now that she's lost her mother, the treatment from her stepsister and stepmother the countess has only grown worse.  One day, her stepsister receives a royal order to move to the northern outskirts due to her unseemly behavior at a recent party.  There, she is to learn proper conduct under the tutelage of the resident prince, rumored to be a cruel man.  Not wanting to subject her daughter to such punishment, the countess decides to send Katrina instead.  Katrina arrives in the north shaking in fear. But contrary to the stories, the "merciless and cold-hearted" prince is kinder than she believed.  Might the pure-hearted Katrina find love in the wintry countryside?

name: The Unusual Prosecutor
overview: An extraordinary prosecutor heads a team that seeks justice for victims using unconventional methods, presenting a new perspective on prosecution.

name: Dead of Winter
overview: When a mentally ill woman accuses her husband of murder, detectives Shen Dongliang and Wu Hongbing uncover a series of interconnected crimes that challenge their pursuit of justice.

name: Zhang Jian - The Legendary Entrepreneur
overview: Set during the final years of the Qing dynasty and the birth of the Republic, the series follows a visionary industrialist whose lifelong pursuit of industry and education helps shape China's path toward modernization.

name: American Classic
overview: Exiled Broadway star Richard Bean returns to his family's small-town theater, igniting hope and chaos in his wake. As old loves resurface and buried secrets emerge Richard and the town are transformed by the power of making art.

name: Kitchen Nightmares
overview: Chef Gordon Ramsay hits the road to help struggling restaurants all over the United States turn their luck around. Ramsay examines the problems each establishment faces, from unsanitary refrigerators to lazy or inexperienced staff, and searches for resolutions. With help from his team, Ramsay redecorates each eatery to give it a fresh new look and updates the menu as needed. Ramsay's ultimate goal is to make the restaurants he visits popular and profitable, but it's up to the restaurateurs to take his advice and turn their business nightmare into the American dream.

name: Dare You to Death
originalName: ไขคดีเป็น เห็นคดีตาย
overview: When seven college students find themselves trapped in a deadly game, two detectives compete to find the killer — even as their attraction grows.

name: THE ONE SHOT
overview: Eight of Japan's top comedians selected by Daigo, including M-1 finalists and King of Conte champions, must each write and direct a short film with just one rule: include a single, hilarious gag. In this unprecedented competition, skilled comedians have just "one shot" to prove their true talent.

name: Love Against Time
overview: A group of young people who survived life-threatening health struggles moves into a house together to find true love. Having faced life's fragility firsthand, they look past the superficial to build deep, intense, and meaningful connections—without wasting a single second.

name: Yiran's Silver Linings
overview: A wedding planner, her disaster-magnet mom, a wannabe star, and their gloriously messy squad—finding light in life’s chaotic comedy.

name: Song of the Samurai - Chapter: Fateful Showdown in Kyoto
originalName: ちるらん 新撰組鎮魂歌 ～京都決戦篇～
overview: Kyoto in the late Edo period. Amidst the intrigue and betrayal swirling within the Mibu Roshigumi, Hijikata Toshizo resolves to become a "demon," caught between friendship and duty. The internal conflict with the tyrant Serizawa Kamo escalates into a life-or-death struggle for his comrades, eventually leading to the final battle in Shimabara. And with that, the age of the sword comes to an end…

name: Worst Ex Ever
overview: From chilling betrayals to murder plots, this true-crime docuseries dissects the dark side of love through eyewitness testimonies.

name: Ultraman Teo
overview: After his home planet, H12, is destroyed by space kaiju, a lone alien named Teo escapes to Earth and lives as a veterinary student. When the same threat arrives, his will to protect transforms him into a giant hero—Ultraman.

name: The One
overview: A successful lawyer who has shut herself off from love after enduring betrayal and painful experiences finds her guarded life changed when a young man from her past returns after five years.

name: Smile After Tears
overview: After a tragic accident tears them apart, a cheerful student finds healing and unexpected love through the boy who stayed beside him.

name: House of Stassi
overview: Schroeder is stepping back into the spotlight to redefine her place in pop culture — but staying on top means confronting the ghosts of her past and a chaotic inner circle with a talent for disrupting her life.

name: Mad Concrete Dreams
overview: A debt-ridden building owner agrees to stage a fake kidnapping to save his family and property, only for the plan to spiral into a real abduction and a dangerously escalating situation.

name: The Criminal
overview: A random mass stabbing, major food company Titus Foods, and a mysterious infant disease. These three things have as much in common as Detective Soma, hack writer Yarimizu, and the stabbing's lone survivor, Shuji. Yet, these men are now embroiled in a risky quest for the truth. What they find, though, is more heinous than they imagined, making them question just who is the real criminal?

name: Ichijyoma Mankitsu Gurashi!
originalName: 一畳間まんきつ暮らし！
overview: Meiko Morita is chosen to transfer into an elite all-girls academy and moves to Tokyo to live in the student dormitory. To her surprise, the dorm also operates as a manga cafe - and she finds herself working there alongside the other residents. This is the beginning of Meiko's new life in a tiny one-tatami room!

name: Song of the Samurai
originalName: Song of the Samurai (Chiruran Shinsengumi Requiem)
overview: Follows the Shinsengumi samurai corps during late-Edo period Kyoto, centered on former street fighter Hijikata Toshizo and his brotherhood with Kondo Isami and Okita Soji as loyalty, betrayal, and war test them.

name: Mom Knows Best?
overview: Nine mothers compete to prove they know their children best; they wager money on predicting their children's choices and discover that their children can still surprise them.

name: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon?

overview: In Orario, fearless adventurers band together in search of fame and fortune within the underground labyrinth known as the Dungeon. But Bell Cranel, novice adventurer, has bigger plans than riches and glory; he fights monsters in the hope of having a fateful encounter with a girl. When this happens, it doesn't go exactly as he planned. Thus begins the story of an unlikely pair, a boy and a goddess, both trying to prove themselves, both eager to reach their goals.

name: Medical Examiner Dr. Qin: Bones of the Past

name: La Stagiaire
overview: After a miscarriage of justice that has led her behind bars, Constance Meyer has decided to take a new career path. At age 50, the farmer and mayor of her village became a student at the National School of the Judiciary.

name: Matka King

name: Mary Kills People
overview: A black comedy about a doctor who illegally helps terminally ill patients with euthanasia and a detective who tracks down her illegal activities.

name: Love Destiny
originalName: บุพเพสันนิวาส
overview: When a modern surgeon's soul is cast into a hated 17th-century troublemaker, he uses advanced medicine to save lives and win over his fierce rival.

name: Golden Curse

In a world of thirty-six secret schools and seventy-two occult arts, the art of “Treasure Hunting” reigns supreme, allowing those who master it to tap into the forces of heaven and earth in pursuit of fortune. Follow Dou Zhanlong, history’s most sinister “God of Wealth,” as he defies fate, rewrites his destiny, and breaks free from an endless cycle of reincarnation.

name: A Trap Called Desire
overview: Falsely accused of murder, a woman loses everything overnight. Determined to reclaim her stolen life, she uncovers a far-reaching conspiracy as she exposes hidden truths and confronts the powerful figures who sacrificed innocent lives to protect their own ambitions.

overview: Ten years after Goblin, Gong Yoo, Lee Dong-wook, Kim Go-eun, and Yoo In-na reunite for a special journey, revisiting iconic locations from the drama and sharing memories, stories, and reflections on one of Korea's most beloved series.

name: Family Kirana Store
overview: A middle-class small-town family's father obsesses over his struggling grocery store attached to their home. He fights to attract customers while facing robberies, counterfeit money, and other threats.

name: Taskmaster Poland
overview: Taskmaster is the Polish version of a global entertainment format that values creativity, a sense of humor, and the ability to handle unusual challenges. Participants take on a series of tasks, and their performance is judged by the titular Taskmaster.

name: The Borderline
overview: A border town cop uncovers an illegal drug trade tied to his childhood friend and a ruthless British crime syndicate operating in the scenic 1000 Islands region between Canada and the U.S.

name: Marbella

Handsome, rich, hedonistic, selfish, ambitious, obsessed with social networks... he knows that to maintain his status he has to be the best in court and the man that everyone knows at the wild Marbella parties, where the numerous criminal groups that do business do business. They operate on the Costa del Sol. César is very clear that, in order not to have problems in life, you have to be friends with everyone and never cross certain lines. But when he least expects it, he discovers that he is in the eye of the hurricane and who needs a lawyer to save him is precisely him.

name: BLACK TRICK: The Lawyer Who Controls Justice
originalName: ブラックトリック～裁きを操る弁護人～
overview: In a society shaped by the internet and media, a lawyer fights to clear the names of those wrongly accused by exposing the truth behind carefully crafted lies.

name: Love Is Never Gone
overview: Teo is a devoted son who dreams of a better life for his family. He falls victim to Yana, a cunning thief known as “Chameleon,” but soon learns she steals out of desperation to care for her sick mother. What begins in anger turns into love, forged through shared loss and sacrifice.  However, Yana’s ties to a crime syndicate lead to betrayal and Teo’s wrongful imprisonment, leaving him convinced she destroyed him. Years later, pardoned and back in the Philippines, Teo tries to rebuild his life, only to discover that Ace Verona’s wife, Gem, is the very image of Yana. As he infiltrates her world seeking justice, he uncovers dangerous secrets about the powerful Verona family and the shocking truth about Gem’s sacrifice to free him. Caught between love, betrayal, and the corruption of a ruthless clan, Teo is forced into a final reckoning where passion, vengeance, and survival collide—proving that love endures even after betrayal.

name: Dearest
overview: After witnessing a murder, famous actress, Wen Jianan, is framed for a deadly accident and stripped of everything she has. As she joins forces with Jiang Yu, a man seeking revenge, they uncover a conspiracy that binds their families together.

name: The Full Story
overview: Each episode of the series tells a different story about real crimes that occurred in Egyptian society, adapted from the program of YouTuber Sameh Sanad.

name: This Is Not a Murder Mystery
originalName: This Is Not a Murder Mystery
overview: Set in the flamboyant 1930s, “This is not a murder mystery” reunites world renowned Surrealist artists, including young Salvador Dalí and René Magritte, who find themselves trapped in a lavish mansion with a mysterious serial killer on the loose.

name: KakuseiHunter Omegahorn
originalName: カクセイハンターオメガホーン
overview:
In ancient times, gigantic creatures called "Mega Horn" ruled the Earth, but they were sealed away in items called "Egorgear" and disappeared. In modern times, humans have emerged using megaphone-like items called "Kakuseiki" to draw out the power of the Mega Horn sealed in the Egorgear. They've come to be known as "Hunters".

Shout the Flame, an explorer well-versed in ancient scripts one day discovers a Kakuseiki and an Egorgear on an altar of an ancient ruin. Confused by the "Omegahorn", which is different from the standard version, he sets the Egorgear in place and a giant horned beast named Enkaku appears! Seeing the qualities of a "king" in Shout's Ego, Enkaku demands to call himself "Captain Omegahorn" and fight alongside him, leading to a battle against a diverse cast of hunters wherever they go.

name: Bust Up
overview: Ten years after their breakup, ex-lovers Mihi and Deb are reunited as reluctant police partners in a small New Zealand town, solving local crimes while confronting unresolved feelings and a larger mystery.

name: Rilakkuma
overview: No matter what your day brings, Rilakkuma—always by your side—is stepping out of the everyday and into a laid-back, expansive world of animation. A moment that makes your heart feel light and carefree. Wherever you are, whatever you’re doing, keep Rilakkuma close by. An exciting new story is about to unfold.

name: My Genie Secretary
overview: Following the massive success of "My Grumpy Secretary", the iconic duo Lee Seo-jin and Kim Kwang-kyu return in this highly anticipated spin-off with a brand-new concept. In "My Genie Secretary", the dynamic pair steps up from being casual managers to becoming true "genies in a lamp" for Korea's top celebrities. This time, they won't just manage public schedules—they will dive deep into their guests' private lives, fears, and ultra-personal daily chores. From chaotic missions at massive music festivals to adrenaline-fueled moments in the celebrities' personal routines, this variety show promises non-stop laughter, realistic bickering between best friends, and an unmatched chemistry.

name: Benidorm Is Murder
overview: Former detective Dennis Crown has swapped the chaos of the UK for a quieter life running a bar in Benidorm. But when tourists start turning up dead, he's reluctantly drawn back into detective work-egged on by his barmaid Rosa, a crime drama superfan. With Dennis's real-world experience and Rosa's encyclopaedic TV knowledge, each episode sees the duo tackling a new murder in paradise, whilst trying to remain on the right side of the local Spanish cops.

name: Pubertat
overview: The harmony of a community is shattered by an allegation of sexual assault on social media that points to three teenagers as the main suspects.

name: Blue Lips
overview: Curiosity gives way to a passionate and complex romance between a reserved shop owner and a rebellious musician.

name: Kiss or Kill
overview: Reunited undercover in a dangerous syndicate, a mercenary and his former ally struggle to resist a forbidden passion while fighting for survival.

name: No Way! My Bro Is the Emperor
overview: Gu Bei, a college slacker, transmigrates into the body of a frontier officer and enjoys a carefree life for three years. Summoned back to the capital by imperial decree, he finds his former roommate, Xiao Ce, now the emperor. Together, they apply modern thinking to outsmart corrupt officials, combat criminal masterminds, and defend the empire, all while generating a series of comedic and action-packed adventures.

name: Battle for Dream Island
overview: Battle for Dream Island (commonly abbreviated as BFDI) is an American reality TV viewer-voting animated web series created by Michael Huang and Cary Huang, who are most known by their YouTube channel name, jacknjellify. The series is about a competition between inanimate, anthropomorphic objects. It premiered on January 1, 2010, and is currently airing its fifth season, with a revival of its third season beginning in the fall. The entire series is uploaded on YouTube, on the channel jacknjellify.

name: The Underworld

But unexpectedly, she runs into her ex-boyfriend Rangsiman, now a powerful television executive. Daran and Rangsiman were deeply in love in their teens, but separated over painful misunderstandings and secrets kept from each other. Rangsiman himself is now engaged to another woman, but he finds himself drawn back to Daran, wanting to understand why she broke up with him and what led her to her current life circumstances. Can they find a way to forgive each other – and will they rekindle their old spark?

overview: Through interviews with the creators, cast and crew, the podcast goes inside the making of Lanterns, from the murder mystery at the heart of the story to the characters, comic lore, and dive into the worldbuilding, and the relationship between Hal Jordan and John Stewart.

Determined to uncover the truth behind the conspiracy that destroyed his family, he begins investigating the forces responsible while working to restore his family's once-respected legacy.

name: Dancing with the Stars: The Next Pro

As long-buried secrets and an old murder case come to light, they uncover unexpected ties that reshape their relationships and destinies.

name: The Vampire Lestat: After Dark
overview: Dive deeper into the world of The Vampire Lestat with this new series that takes fans behind the scenes of each episode with members of the cast and creative team. Hosted by writer and podcaster Lizzie Bassett.

He engages in legal conflicts and complex personalities, trying to put his life back together after separation, proving that the most difficult case that a person may plead is his own personal case against his new reality.

name: Serendipity
overview: Five interconnected stories examine the emotional struggles of ordinary people as they face revenge, loss, identity, unwavering devotion, and the challenges of mental health.

Reborn in the body of a rural thug who shares his name, he experiences mortal life firsthand and comes to understand the importance of balance.

name: My Idol, My Debut
overview: A coming-of-age story about a devoted fan who time-slips eight years into the past to save their favorite idol from a tragic accident. While trying to change fate by preventing his debut, the fan ends up becoming an idol trainee themselves.

overview: A descendant of a legendary tomb-raiding family infiltrates four powerful clans before returning to a mysterious tomb from 20 years earlier, where deadly traps and supernatural horrors reveal a long-hidden truth.

Through exclusive interviews and behind-the-scenes footage, the series examines his leadership style, the team's culture, and the journey that led to one of the greatest achievements in Argentine football history.

name: Make It Right 2026
originalName: รักออกเดิน 2026
overview: After his first love falls apart, a student grows closer to a quiet classmate as he and his friends face the highs and lows of young love.

name: Filter
overview: You're sixteen. You're still figuring out your sexuality, your relationships and your values. And you make mistakes. Matty is an introverted boy who, despite his indecisive and hesitant nature, has managed to come out, thanks to a family and friends who support him. But when he falls in love with Radek, a boy his own age, during the entrance exams for an art high school, he runs headfirst into the reality of first emotional confusion, missteps and failures. Acting in good faith, he makes a few mistakes that quickly snowball into bigger ones. Within a few weeks his childishly naive world turns cruelly adult, and he suddenly has to face unexpected problems and the incomprehension of those around him. Will he manage to find a fragile inner balance in the storm of a complicated adolescence?

name: Stokes Twins
overview: From secret rooms to outrageous pranks and challenges, the Stokes Twins turn the impossible into reality in this mix of their most-watched videos.

name: Formula 1
overview: Formula 1 is the highest class of international single-seater auto racing sanctioned by the Fédération Internationale de l'Automobile (FIA) and owned by the Formula One Group. Formula One consists of a series of races, known as Grands Prix which take place worldwide on purpose-built circuits and on public roads.

name: El Joven de la Foto
overview: Pablo Franco, an honest but inexperienced assistant, is assigned alongside Raúl—the unit's most renowned investigator—to solve a mysterious death at a remote religious seminary. Thanks to his incredible shrewdness, Pablo quickly identifies the suspects, only to discover that everything is a trap devised by Raúl, who has been bribed to protect the killer. Pablo must risk his own life to uncover the true murderer.

name: 100 Cooks
overview: It is the biggest home cook competition of all time. Actor, television host and former pro football player Terry Crews hosts as 100 of America's elite home cooks enter the stadium kitchen arena where they will be challenged to the most unpredictable, professional-chef level cooking competition ever. As the competition begins, chefs are selected at random to come to the floor to compete while the "Challenge Mixer" dictates the challenges they will face ranging from fast-paced trivia contests to 30-minute do-or-die cooking battles. Top culinary content creator Nick DiGiovanni and chef and NYT best-selling cookbook author Alex Guarnaschelli are the judges that determine who stays and who goes. Each round's winner will be given a chance to take the cash or add it to the ever-growing grand prize pot, which starts at $100,000...so as the number of cooks goes down, the grand prize goes up.

name: Deadly Influence: The Social Media Murders
originalName: Deadly Influence: The Social Media Murders

name: ALL or NOTHING
overview: Six idols – Lee Teuk and Shin Dong of Super Junior, Kim Yo Han of WEi, Johnny and Ji Sung of NCT, and soloist DAWN – are all set to spend a week together in Egypt. Of course, there's a twist involved: as they travel, they must complete a series of missions that will affect their future plans. The winners will become "princes," receiving luxury accommodations, meals and other perks, while the losers become “beggars,” continuing their journey under limited conditions. Each mission becomes a battle to decide who will travel in comfort and style, and who will have to tough it out.

originalName: The Idaho Murders: A College Town Nightmare
overview: In the fall of 2022, four University of Idaho students were found murdered in an off-campus house in the quiet college town of Moscow. As fear spread through the community, investigators faced intense pressure to solve a case marked by few immediate answers. This new documentary unpacks the chilling crime, the investigation that followed, and the lasting impact on a town forever changed.
